description: Rules pertaining to the madd muttaṣil. Madd muttaṣil (attached) is the madd that occurs when hamzah appears in the same word after a letter of madd.

madd_muttasil_warsh_hamza.title: Ṭūl on muttaṣil
madd_muttasil_warsh_hamza.description: While in the lines themselves Imam Shaṭibī does not clarify the lengths to apply on madd muttaṣil. His prominent student, Imam Sakhāwī, related that Imām Shāṭbī used to narrate ṭūl for Imāms Warsh and Ḥamzah and tawassuṭ for the rest.

madd_muttasil_rest.title: Tawassuṭ on muttaṣil
